image_description: A vertical, rectangular pub sign mounted on a rough-hewn stone wall. The sign features a red background with the Prince of Wales's feathers (three white ostrich feathers emerging from a gold coronet) and a blue ribbon with text. Below the crest, the name 'WADWORTH' is displayed in gold lettering. The sign is suspended from a black metal bracket attached to the wall, topped with a small lighting fixture.
